subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased and made editable, or replace it with a maintainer-owned narrow fix?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate is in a fork, conflicts with current main, and cannot be edited by maintainers.

options.title: Replace the fork PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repo fix, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

options.title: Ask for contributor rebase
options.body: Keep the issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it onto current main and enable maintainer edits if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open until the contributor returns, accepting that the source-reproducible rendering bug remains unresolved meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Replace the fork PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repo fix, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the TUI leading-stripper follow-up and are the clearest routing owner for the shared UI/TUI display boundary.
